verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is Claude Code's core interaction model. The official repo says it handles routine tasks, code explanation and git workflows "all through natural language commands", and the docs say users "describe what you want in plain language", with example prompts such as implementing a JIRA issue and opening a PR. Natural-language requests also work from Slack via @Claude mentions. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language control works reliably; community reports criticize output quality rather than the natural-language interface itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows -- all through natural language commands
Describe what you want in plain language. Claude Code plans the approach, writes the code across multiple files, and verifies it works.
Implement features from issue trackers: "Add the feature described in JIRA issue ENG-4521 and create a PR on GitHub."
Route tasks from team chat: mention @Claude in Slack with a bug report and get a pull request back
